task_text: 给定图片随以下声明流传："Photo shows 'Modi No Entry' billboard in Rajasthan during Prime Minister Narendra Modi's visit."（声明日期：2023-05-31）。依据证据尽量查明这张图片最早在哪里、何时发布，以及它的原始语境是否与声明相符。引用所依据的来源与日期，说明未能确定的内容。
task_text_en: The given image circulated with the following claim: "Photo shows 'Modi No Entry' billboard in Rajasthan during Prime Minister Narendra Modi's visit." (claim date: 2023-05-31). Find where and when this image was first published, as far as the evidence allows, and whether its original context matches the claim. Cite the sources and dates you rely on, and state what could not be determined.
claims: Photo shows 'Modi No Entry' billboard in Rajasthan during Prime Minister Narendra Modi's visit.

requirements.text: 这张图片能查到的最早一份（网站、页面）及其日期，以及日期的性质（页面声明 / 上传 / 存档，只能说明"不晚于"）
requirements.text_en: The earliest copy of the image that can be found (site, page) and its date, with what kind of date it is (declared by the page, upload, archive capture; it only shows 'no later than')

requirements.text: 最早那份所说的图片内容（地点、时间、事件）与声明是否相符
requirements.text_en: Whether what the earliest copy says the picture shows (place, time, event) matches the claim

requirements.text: 未能确定的内容与结论的适用范围
requirements.text_en: What could not be determined and the scope of the conclusion

required_evidence.description: SEARCH 日期查询的结果（页面声明 / 上传 / 最早存档）
检索打开的、载有这张图片的页面

checks.note: 标注：最早发布 2019-02-09（When was the picture taken?）；范围放宽到前 1 个月、后 6 个月（找到的可能是较晚的转载）
